notes: rp: AV EARNINGS_CALL_TRANSCRIPT (ASTS 2026Q2) returned ACCESS DENIED / rate_limit (25 requests/day) once; not retried. Fallback: web transcripts (Tiger/TTM for Q2 2026, Motley Fool via Webull for Q4 2025) and a MarketBeat call summary for Q1 2026; all read through a summarizing fetch (retrieval search_excerpt), so quotes are near-verbatim, not the official transcript.

rp: Guidance record. FY2026 revenue $150-200M first given on the 2026-03-02 call ("full-year 2026 revenue in the range of $150 million to $200 million"), reaffirmed 2026-05-11 (about half expected from existing contracted backlog) and 2026-08-10 (sequential growth each quarter; CFO: revenue likely weighted toward Q4). H1 2026 delivered $46.2M = 23-31% of the range; H2 must deliver $104-154M (vs $69.0M in H2 2025). Track ratio on H2 2025 revenue: 69.0/62.5 = 1.10 (beat, upper half).

rp: Opex guidance was RAISED: 2026-03-02 CFO guided adjusted opex ex cost of revenue ~$70-80M per quarter for 2026; 2026-08-10 the full-year average became ~$100M per quarter and Q3 2026 $105-115M. Actuals ran above the guided midpoint twice (Q1 79.8 vs 75 mid, ratio 1.06; Q2 95.9 vs 85-95, ratio 1.07, above the top). The company spends more than it guides on opex.

rp: Capex: Q1 2026 guided "flat with Q4 2025" (Q4 number not reached, see gaps); Q1 actual $261.6M came below guidance because a launch payment slipped into Q2 (MarketBeat summary of the CFO). Q2 2026 guided $575-650M, actual $597.6M on the cash-flow line (CFO said ~$610M): inside range. Q3 2026 guided $350-425M.

rp: Deployment guidance SLIPPED twice: 10-K/FY2025 release (2026-03-02): 45-60 satellites in orbit by end of 2026, launch every 1-2 months, commercial service activation targeted 2H 2026; Q1 10-Q (2026-05-11): approximately 45 by end of 2026; Q2 10-Q (2026-08-10): approximately 45 BB satellites in early 2027 ("based on our current expectations regarding launch availability"). On the Q2 call the President said commercial service launches when at least 45 satellites are up and targeted late 2026 for consumer readiness/beta. 13 in orbit at 2026-08-10 (5 Block 1 + BB6 + BB8-13); BB7 was lost 2026-04-19 (New Glenn placed it in a lower than planned orbit).

rp: Management meaning of the numbers: revenue today is gateway hardware sales to MNOs (near cost: Q2 product margin ~8%) and U.S. government milestone services; no SpaceMobile Service revenue has been recognized to date. Service revenue will be recognized over contract life starting when MNOs get network access; MNO revenue-share consideration is variable and excluded from RPO. RPO ~$1.2B with only ~6.6% inside 12 months: the backlog is mostly service-period revenue after activation. Management "backlog" $1.30B is its own broader measure (adds U.S. Government awards).

rp: One-offs to normalize: Q2 2026 $125.9M loss on involuntary conversion (BB7 write-off net of insurance; replacement launch expected under the contract); H1 2026 $89.8M induced conversion expense; H1 2026 $1.2M warrant remeasurement loss (2025 had $68.2M). SBC rose to $63.5M in Q2 2026 from $10.5M in Q2 2025 (headcount growth plus higher SBC) and is excluded from the company's adjusted opex: treat it as a real recurring cost.

rp: Capital structure (for capital_bridge): converts outstanding after July 2026 approx. $3.5M 2032 4.25% (conv $26.99), $325M 2032 2.375% (conv $72.07; effective $120.12 with capped call), $1,150M 2036 2.00% (effective $96.30), $1,075M 2036 2.25% (conv $116.30), $1,150M 2034 1.625% (conv $79.57; effective $149.20) = ~$3.70B principal; plus the cash-collateralized $420M UBS loan, an undrawn $550M Sound Point facility (conditional on Ligado closing), and the Trinity equipment loan (balance not extracted). Economic shares at 2026-08-06: 389.2M (Class A 299.8M + 89.4M AST LLC units behind Class B/C). Repeated convert issuance and equitizations (Feb 2026 equitized $296.5M of 2032 notes) are the funding model: management says it will keep raising equity, equity-linked or debt capital.

rp: Funding statements: management says it is "fully funded" for the costs to manufacture and launch ~90 BB satellites (Q2 10-Q) and estimates $21-23M average capital cost per Block 2 satellite (initial launches higher); cash on hand covers the next 12 months; commitments $775-795M plus launch milestone payments. Ligado: $520M paid is refundable via a $520M backstop only if regulatory approvals fail; approvals are still pending and may be affected by litigation with Inmarsat.
